ns2:section.sectionText: This is an online course taught on Compass for non-NRES majors. There are no classroom sessions. However, you must be present for evening exams at 7:00 pm in 100 Greg Hall on April 6 and April 20, the final exam date and time to be announced at a later date. Course is limited to first 250 students who enroll, and will be opened for registration on January 19, 2010. Further information at: http://go.illinois.edu/NRES102
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Not intended for students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department.
